card.name: "Most" after a comma, as in "most notably"
card.fires_on: The word "most" right after a comma that follows a noun, where it begins an adverb like "most notably", "most importantly" or "most recently". It also fires on the comma itself when a clause is about to be added.

modes.label: most after comma
modes.description: "most" opens an adverb phrase giving a prominent example after a list-like noun.
modes.example: Feynman helped to popularize the subject through his books and lectures,<< most>> notably in The Feynman Lectures

modes.label: comma before example
modes.description: The comma itself, where "most notably" or "which" could come next.
modes.example: and a few goalkeepers<<,>> most notably Miguel Calero, wear baseball

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "most" (as in "most notably") next.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a comma where the text is about to say "most notably" or "most importantly" to single out an example.
